US proposes stricter H-1B visa scrutiny, ends automatic work permits

The United States has proposed increased scrutiny for H-1B visa extensions and will end automatic work permit renewals for certain visa holders. Concurrently, New Zealand First has proposed replacing its Accredited Employer Work Visa (AEWV) with a more stringent skilled work visa.
